title: Service Test 56: Ice maker error codes (E0–E5)

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU French Door Refrigerator (W11509412A, ~27 cu ft)
source.oemTestTitle: Ref. Compartment Ice Maker Error Codes

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered at step 01. Press SW5/SW4 to navigate to the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW5 to move to the next step in the sequence. Press SW4 to back up.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 56
steps.body: In Service Diagnostics Mode, press SW5 to advance until the dispenser display shows 56. Press SW4 to go back. Amber Order Filter = step number; red Replace Filter = step result.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 56 — Ice maker error codes

steps.title: Active ice maker error code
steps.body: Display shows active ice maker error. Which code is displayed?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Display shows active ice maker error. Which code is displayed?

steps.title: Ice maker OK
steps.oemOutcome: E0 — ice maker reports no errors. If no ice, check fill (test 45), fill tube (test 19), and ice box cooling (tests 36–37).

steps.title: E1 — No cooling in ice compartment
steps.oemOutcome: E1 — ice compartment unable to reach temperature. Run tests 36 (ice box fan) and 37 (ice box thermistor); verify sealed system.

steps.title: E2 — Motor home not found
steps.oemOutcome: E2 — harvest motor did not find home. Run test 59; check for obstructions in ice maker module.

steps.title: E3 — Mold heater time-out
steps.oemOutcome: E3 — mold heater on too long without reaching temperature. Run test 58 heater/thermistor path.

steps.title: E4 — Dry cycle
steps.oemOutcome: E4 — dry cycles above minimum. Run test 45 water fill and test 19 fill tube heater; verify water valve P3-3.

steps.title: E5 — Ice maker thermistor fault
steps.oemOutcome: E5 — mold thermistor fault. Run test 58; measure IM thermistor at P7-1/P7-2.
